A '''zombie rat''' is a monster only found in [[Melzar's Maze]]. It has three versions: small with a normal tail, large, and small with a cut tail. All versions have the same stats. During the [[Dragon Slayer]] quest and afterwards, players can kill the small rat with the normal tail to obtain a [[Key (Melzar's Maze)|red key]], used to advance in the maze.

The zombie rat is quite similar to the [[giant rat]] except with a few cuts, gashes, and a washed-out colour. There are also several other [[undead]] monsters in the maze - such as [[zombie]]s, [[skeleton]]s and [[ghost]]s.
